entry: Long: MACD line crosses above the signal line, the cross happens below the zero line, and price is above the 200 EMA.
Short: MACD line crosses below the signal line, the cross happens above the zero line, and price is below the 200 EMA.
exit: Take profit at 1.5 times the risk.
stop_loss: Long: stop below the pullback low (short is the mirror; no buffer is given).
filters: 200 EMA trend filter: buys only above it, sells only below it.
Skip trades whose signals are unclear.
Risk 1% per trade. The example uses a 30-minute chart (EUR/USD, then EUR/JPY).
